answer: Here is a specific defense: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The yarrow of work and the harbor of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a jetty to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
